audit_findings.title: The bridge may omit non-current investments after purging their income
audit_findings.magnitude: $350.643m, or $1.94 per diluted share and 18.1% of base equity value
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the fair value of the Company’s portfolio of debt securities amounted to $379,376,000, with amortized cost amounts totaling $376,589,000, maturities that do not exceed five years, and a yield to maturity of 4.19%.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated omission: the $404.37m bridge equals July cash and cash equivalents of $302.521m plus current investments of $101.849m, excluding filed non-current investments of $350.643m even though investment income is purged from OE. Adding that asset would increase base value from approximately $10.72 to $12.66 per share before considering $5.051m of accrued interest.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the July securities schedule and accrued interest to the bridge, then rerun all scenarios and the 30% margin-of-safety threshold with confirmed non-operating investments included once.

audit_findings.title: The null perimeter conflicts with an announced Moritex divestiture
audit_findings.magnitude: $11.519m net proceeds; disposed business represented approximately 2% of 2025 revenue; OE impact unquantified
audit_findings.evidence: On February 11, 2026, the Company disclosed its intent to divest its Japan‑focused trading business, which was acquired as part of the Moritex acquisition, for a target purchase price between $ 10 million and $ 12 million, including the sale of related inventories.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter error is demonstrated: the business was sold on April 1, 2026, while the valuation records a null perimeter. The July cash balance already incorporates the sale proceeds, but historical OE includes the disposed business. Its profitability is not disclosed, so the direction and materiality of removing its earnings cannot be established from its 2% revenue contribution alone.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the disposed business's 2023-2025 operating profit, taxes, capital spending and working-capital contribution, remove them from the OE history and trend, and confirm that the $11.519m net proceeds enter only through July cash.

audit_findings.title: An existing tax claim may be absent from the incompletely parsed bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $24.935m, or $0.14 per diluted share and 1.3% of base equity value
audit_findings.evidence: The Company’s reserve for income taxes, including gross interest and penalties, was $ 27,042,000 as of December 31, 2025, of which $ 24,269,000 was classified as a non-current liability and $ 2,773,000 was classified as an offset to deferred tax assets.
audit_findings.explanation: The latest filing establishes a $24.935m reserve, including $21.963m classified as a non-current liability and $2.972m offset against deferred-tax assets. Even deducting the entire reserve from equity would reduce base value by only about $0.14 per share, versus the $51.53 gap between the $62.25 market price and $10.72 base value. Some reserve may also expire or already be represented in projected cash taxes, so a full bridge deduction would be conservative.
audit_findings.action: Confirm expected cash settlement and timing and whether forecast cash taxes already capture it; deduct only the uncaptured cash-settlement amount to avoid double counting.

audit_findings.title: Upfront one-time license revenue may contaminate the 2025 owner-earnings observation
audit_findings.magnitude: $13m one-time revenue, including $10.365m of unbilled license revenue; OE impact unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: 2025 OE, fitted trend and future working-capital collections
audit_findings.evidence: As a result of the upfront recognition of the license revenue and transfer of inventories, the Company recognized one-time revenue of approximately $ 13 million in 2025, which is included in the "Standard products and services" amount in the table above.
audit_findings.explanation: The one-time accounting revenue is demonstrated, but its effect on OE is unresolved because the record does not show how transferred-inventory cost, taxes and the increase in unbilled revenue entered the OE calculation. If recurring profit remained in 2025 OE or later collections are counted as new earnings, the trend anchor and value would be overstated; the supplied figures cannot quantify the net effect.
audit_findings.action: Reconstruct the transaction's after-tax contribution to 2025 OE, including inventory cost and unbilled-revenue working capital, then refit the trend after removing any nonrecurring contribution and prevent future receivable collections from being counted as new earnings.

audit_findings.title: The $33.2 million tax-law remeasurement requires internally consistent normalization
audit_findings.magnitude: $33.237m, equal to 30.4% of the $109.4m anchor OE; filed expected annual cash-tax benefit is $12m-$15m
audit_findings.mechanism: 2025 OE, forecast cash taxes and deferred-tax bridge treatment
audit_findings.evidence: As a result of this legislation, in 2025, the Company accrued a discrete tax expense of $ 33,237,000 to increase its NCTI deferred tax liability.
audit_findings.explanation: The discrete deferred-tax charge is filed and large relative to anchor OE. Retaining a noncash remeasurement understates normalized OE, while adding it back without forecasting the resulting NCTI cash taxes or consistently treating the associated deferred liability can overstate value. The scale is reasonably capable of materially changing the OE anchor and scenario values.
audit_findings.action: Trace the $33.237m charge through the 2025 OE calculation, document the forecast cash-tax rate and reversal schedule, and rerun the OE trend and scenarios using one internally consistent treatment of the charge and associated liability.

audit_findings.title: The 2025 property-sale gain may remain in normalized earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $5.053m pretax; a conservative full-anchor capitalization is approximately $71.0m or $0.39 per share before tax and trend-fit attenuation
audit_findings.evidence: Other income (expense) increased by $6,446,000 from the prior year primarily due to a $5,053,000 gain on the sale of the 19,000 square-foot building adjacent to our corporate headquarters and the underlying land.
audit_findings.explanation: Whether the gain was removed is unresolved, but its filed scale is not capable of changing the valuation conclusion. Even treating the entire pretax gain as a permanent addition to anchor OE and applying the base operating-PV multiple produces only about $0.39 per share, versus the $51.53 gap between market price and base value; taxation and the ten-year trend fit would reduce the actual effect.
audit_findings.action: Confirm that the $5.053m gain was excluded from 2025 OE and that the $6.704m sale proceeds entered only through the balance sheet; rerun the trend only if the gain was retained.
